grades.quote: The range of valid inputs for FCVT. _int_ .D and the behavior for invalid inputs are the same as for FCVT. _int_ .S.
grades.reason: This passage covers the D-extension conversions (FCVT.W.D etc.). It only says that invalid-input behavior matches FCVT.int.S. It gives no actual result value or flags for an out-of-range FCVT.W.S, so it offers limited auxiliary information.
This passage describes the Zfa FROUND/FROUNDNX round-to-integer instructions. They produce floating-point results and are unrelated to FCVT.W.S out-of-range results or flags.
